subject: Request: additional pilot credits for LaunchPad Ventures cohort
messages:
From: Natalie Ramos <natalie@launchpadv.com>
To: tessa_morgan@redwood.com
Date: 2027-08-01T09:12:00-07:00
Subject: Request: additional pilot credits for LaunchPad Ventures cohort

Hi Tessa,

Thanks again for the demo last week — the team here is excited about Redwood's latency and cost profile. We're onboarding a new cohort for our accelerator and would like to extend the pilot to 12 teams rather than the 5 in the standard package.

Specifically, would Redwood consider providing an additional 200k token credit allotment for the 8-week pilot (on top of the standard trial credits)? That would let each team run full integration tests and one end-to-end demo before Demo Day.

Attached is a short SOW that outlines timing and expected usage patterns. We're a bit tight on budget this cycle and an approval on credits would lock us into a preferred pilot partner. Happy to sign a short mutual action plan / MOU if that helps.

Thanks —
Natalie Ramos
Program Lead, LaunchPad Ventures
[natalie@launchpadv.com]
[attachment: LaunchPad_SOW_v1.pdf]

From: tessa_morgan@redwood.com
To: Natalie Ramos <natalie@launchpadv.com>
Cc: ben_carter@redwood.com
Date: 2027-08-01T11:03:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Request: additional pilot credits for LaunchPad Ventures cohort

Natalie —

Appreciate the SOW and the fast follow. Short answer: we can usually accommodate expanded pilots, but we need to align internally on approvals and minimal contractual terms.

Next steps I propose:
- I’ll loop in Ben (growth) to confirm promotional approval and quota.
- If approved, we typically require a short MOU with usage caps and a commitment to a single point-of-contact for the cohort.
- Please share expected peak QPS and average sequence length per call (you included rough numbers but we need a short table) — that'll help us size the token allotment and recommend batching/quantization settings.

I’ve cc’d Ben here. I’ll follow up by EOD tomorrow with a formal response.

Best,
Tessa Morgan
Head of Ecosystem Programs
Redwood Inference

Hey all —

We generally support cohort expansions like this when there is clear product fit and a single onboarding lead. A few internal guardrails:
- Standard promo allotment for expanded pilots is up to 150k tokens beyond trial for accelerators; exceptions require Growth + Sales Ops signoff.
- We’d ask LaunchPad to agree to a usage cap per team and a reporting cadence (bi-weekly usage + 1 end-of-pilot summary).
- If LaunchPad is willing to commit to a discounted post-pilot conversion path (e.g., a reserved capacity talk if > 20% convert), we can stretch to 200k tokens.

Natalie — would LaunchPad consider a simple MOU that includes the usage cap and conversion touchpoint? If yes, I’ll route an internal exception request.

Thanks,
Ben Carter
Senior Growth Manager, Redwood
[attachment: pilot_credit_terms.docx]

From: dev_patel@redwood.com
To: ben_carter@redwood.com; tessa_morgan@redwood.com; Natalie Ramos <procurement@launchpadv.com>
Date: 2027-08-03T14:08:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Request: additional pilot credits for LaunchPad Ventures cohort

Following up with the legal/procurement perspective. A couple of notes before we approve an exception:

1) We need an MOU with: scope, start/end dates, per-team usage cap, escalation path for overages, and data handling assurances (we'll rely on standard SOC2 language but call out any special requests).
2) For accounting, credits will be recorded as promotional credits with an expiration 90 days after issuance unless otherwise negotiated. If LaunchPad needs credits valid for the whole 8-week cohort plus a 2-week wrap-up, call that out.
3) If LaunchPad asks for an invoiced credit (vs. platform promo), procurement@launchpadv.com should send a PO; otherwise we'll issue credits on the platform after MOU countersign.

I can provisionally approve up to 200k tokens if the MOU is accepted and procurement confirms either PO or acceptance of the credit expiry terms.

- Dev Patel
Legal & Procurement Counsel, Redwood Inference

Tessa / Ben / Dev —

Thanks for the quick turnaround and clarity. LaunchPad is happy to sign a 2-page MOU with the following high-level bullets:
- Pilot dates: 2027-09-01 to 2027-10-27 (8 weeks + 1 wrap week)
- Token allotment: 200,000 promotional tokens to be issued to LaunchPad master account and distributed across teams per the attached allocation table
- Usage cap: 40,000 tokens per team with overage notification and temporary throttling if the cohort exceeds 85% of allotment
- Reporting: bi-weekly usage email to tessa_morgan@redwood.com and a final summary report
- Procurement: we'll issue a PO if required, but prefer platform-issued credits and acceptance of 90-day expiration.

Attached: signed MOU draft (redlined) and the team allocation table. Please confirm and we can route for countersignature.

Best,
Natalie Ramos
